name: Liquid-Rupture Logo Reveal Story Film
description: A cinematic social brand film that turns a fictional logo reveal into a short narrative: tension gathers in liquid colour fields, the system finds form, one rupture exposes the identity, and the final lockup lands with editorial restraint.
whatYouGet: A 20–45 second wide narrative video with six to ten orchestrated scenes
Warm paper composition with glass-fringe refraction and metaball-style colour merging
A single controlled rupture that reveals the final fictional identity lockup
Offline-safe HTML/CSS animation rendered to a local MP4
A proof beat and end card designed for social-feed readability
goodFit: Brand launches that need a distinctive identity moment
Art-direction tests for social campaigns and motion systems
Fictional product concepts requiring a polished reveal film
notFor: Detailed software tutorials or feature-heavy product explainers
Exact reproduction or animation of an existing trademarked logo
requiredInputs: Fictional brand name and exact lockup text
Short campaign promise or positioning line
Optional proof point, metric, or launch message

faq.q: Can I use an existing logo file?
faq.a: Use the skill for a fictional or rights-cleared identity lockup supplied as text or simple shape guidance. It does not trace, modify, or reproduce trademarked logo artwork.

faq.q: How is the liquid effect created?
faq.a: The renderer builds it locally with layered HTML/CSS shapes, gradients, blur, border highlights, transforms, and timed easing. No image or video generation model is required.

faq.q: Can the rupture happen more than once?
faq.a: The signature direction is strongest with one decisive rupture. Additional small transitions are acceptable, but they should not read as separate impact events.

demoPrompt: /sl-liquid-rupture-logo-reveal-story-film Create a 29-second 16:9 social film for fictional brand Rillform. Open with “Before the signal” and “Every identity starts as a pressure in the field.” Move through separation and tension, a system finding shape, rising clarity, a launch-note quote, and gather-to-resolve beats. Close with “Shape finds signal.” Use a restrained paper-rupture style.
followUpPrompts: Make the rupture slower and more sculptural while keeping the final lockup on screen for four seconds.
Replace the proof beat with a compact three-step checklist for a launch campaign.
Create a calmer version with less blur, more visible paper grain, and a smaller wordmark.
externalCostNote: No external services or generation models. Renders locally.
